source_refs.section: How to turn Stolen Device Protection on or off, Always require additional security measures
source_refs.applicability: iPhone with iOS 17.3 or later; the extra measures apply only when the iPhone is away from familiar locations unless this option is chosen
source_refs.verified_excerpt: are required only when your iPhone is away from familiar locations.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone with iOS 17.3 or later: The extra measures are required only when your iPhone is away from familiar locations. To require them everywhere, go to Settings, tap 'Face ID & Passcode', then tap 'Stolen Device Protection' and choose 'Always' under 'Require Security Delay'. With this option, updates to certain security settings always require a delay, and biometric-only actions apply even if you are in a familiar location like home or work.

source_refs.title: Protect your personal data against theft - Android Help
source_refs.applicability: Android; some steps require Android 10 or later; some features require Android 15 or later; not supported on Android Go devices, tablets, or wearables
source_refs.verified_excerpt: To minimize the impact of phone theft, protect your data and your device with security features.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android: Open your device's Settings app. Tap 'Google', then 'All services'. Under 'Personal & device safety', tap 'Theft protection'. Theft protection is not supported on Android Go devices, tablets, or wearables. You must set a screen lock (PIN, pattern, or password) first.

source_refs.title: Protect your personal data against theft - Android Help
source_refs.applicability: Android; Identity Check requires a Google Account, a screen lock, biometrics, and trusted places
source_refs.verified_excerpt: To verify your identity, Identity Check requires biometrics and other safeguards.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android: Tap 'Identity Check'. Under 'To activate', complete the required steps: sign in to a Google Account, add a screen lock, add biometrics (Fingerprint or Face Unlock), and add your trusted places such as Home or Work. Then tap 'Done'. Adding a verified phone number makes it easier to recover your Google Account.

source_refs.title: Protect your personal data against theft - Android Help
source_refs.applicability: Android with Identity Check set up; applies outside trusted places
source_refs.verified_excerpt: will strictly enforce biometric authentication like fingerprint or face
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android: Outside your trusted places, any app that asks you to 'Verify it's you' will strictly enforce biometric authentication like fingerprint or face. A PIN, pattern, or password does not work for those prompts. Exceptions where a PIN, pattern, or password can still be used: Private space, Multi-users mode, autofill payments in apps, and password and payments autofill in Chrome.
